messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Renewal for BeaconHealth lands in two weeks. Procurement just flagged that they require separate signers for the CC payment instrument and the invoice/PO. They also want an itemized SOW attached to the invoice. Can we confirm who signs what?
Jordan Lee: Ack. Do we have the billing entity and tax ID they will use? That determines the invoice recipient.
Maya Patel: They said 'BeaconHealth US Inc (EIN 12-3456789)' in email, but procurement asked for the registered name on the PO to match the tax docs. I'll paste the screenshot in the thread.
Priya Singh: From enablement side — if we need to get a new signer up to speed (api keys, admin console), we should schedule a 30-min walkthrough before renewal effective date. I can do next Tue/Wed.
Ravi Menon: I'm looping FinanceOps. @FinanceOps can you confirm whether we can accept CC for the renewal while PO for the onboarding services is processed? Customer prefers CC but procurement insists on PO for SOW items.
FinanceOps: Generally we can accept mixed flow but we need the PO to match invoice lines for recognition. Please provide the PO-number and exact invoice lines. Example snippet we need:```
1x Redwood Dedicated - 12 months - $48,000
Onboarding services - 1x - $6,000
Tax ID: 12-3456789
```
FinanceOps: Also need the billing contact name and email to put on the invoice.
Maya Patel: Procurement asked for delegated signer on the PO (someone in procurement) and the CFO to sign the contract. They want the contract countersigned within the same week. CFO availability is limited. Any workaround?
Jordan Lee: Legal prefers the CFO for material amendments > $50k but can accept delegated CFO designee with written authorization. @LegalBot — can you confirm required authorization format?
LegalBot: Required: a scanned letter on company letterhead naming the designee + a signature block for the CFO OR a notarized power of attorney. PDF preferred. No exceptions for enterprise contracts.
Priya Singh: I'll include the admin walkthrough invite in the Docsend and confirm attendee list. Can someone upload the final SOW + invoice line items to Docsend?
Ravi Menon: Uploaded a draft here: https://docsend.com/s/abc123 - filename: BeaconHealth_SOW_v3.pdf. Maya please confirm content; FinanceOps — can you validate invoice lines in that doc?
FinanceOps: Reviewing now. One note: split onboarding as a separate invoice line (so PO can reference it explicitly).
Maya Patel: Customer wants renewal effective 2025-06-01. To hit that we need signed PO + authorization by 2025-05-28. Can everyone confirm if that's feasible? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jordan Lee: We can aim for that. I'll reach out to the customer's procurement lead for the PO number today.
Priya Singh: Available for enablement Tue 5/27 10am PT. I'll hold a slot.
Ravi Menon: I'll chase the CFO designee authorization once procurement confirms PO.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Quick checklist: (1) Procurement PO number + scanned authorization (2) Final SOW uploaded to Docsend (3) Enablement invite sent (4) Finance validates invoice lines. If all green by 5/28 we hit 6/1 effective.
Jordan Lee: Noted. I'll update thread with PO when I get it. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks team — ping me if any blockers.
__notes: This thread simulates a renewal execution coordination discussion: signer delegation, PO vs CC, enablement scheduling, Docsend link, legal authorization, and invoice line requirements. Messages are short and Slack-style with inline code block for invoice example.
